gui.autolibrarian.config.title: Auto Librarian settings
gui.autolibrarian.config_tips.show_statu: Displays the current status of the mod while it is running.
gui.autolibrarian.config_tips.using_colo:
When the trade price with a villager matches the theoretical value, the text color of the emerald price displayed in the chat changes to a special color.
§dThe lowest price is displayed in this color.
§4The highest value is displayed in this color.
§7§oIf this setting is enabled, the formatting codes in the JSON will be ignored.
gui.autolibrarian.config_tips.using_axe: If an axe is in your hotbar when the lectern is destroyed, it will be used automatically.
gui.autolibrarian.config_tips.axe_protec: This setting prevents axes from being destroyed when used by a mod.

You can specify the durability threshold at which the axe breakage protection activates.
The mod will continue to use the axe until its durability reaches the specified value.
gui.autolibrarian.config_tips.foundafter: You can configure the behavior when the desired enchanted book appears in the trade offers.
status.autolibrarian.wait_unemployed: Waiting for villager to become unemployed...
status.autolibrarian.wait_librarian: Waiting for villager to become a librarian...

message.autolibrarian.no_lectern: §cTo use AutoLibrarian, please prepare a lectern in your hotbar.
message.autolibrarian.axes_tip: §bTip: Having an axe in your hotbar allows you to retrieve the lectern more quickly.
